grammarFocus: to do 表目的；动词后接 to do / doing 的常见用法；基础被动语态入门。
title: A Smart Speaker Mix-Up
instructions: 听录音，完成10个问题。录音会播放两遍。第一遍听大意，第二遍注意细节。所有题目答案均来自录音内容。本材料为模拟练习，不是官方雅思考试。
transcript:
Mia: Ben, can you help me? My smart speaker isn't working.
Ben: Sure. What's the problem?
Mia: I say 'Turn on the light', but nothing happens. I want to use it to control my lights.
Ben: Let me check. Is it plugged in?
Mia: Yes, it is. The light on it is red.
Ben: A red light usually means it's not connected to Wi-Fi. Did you move it to a new room?
Mia: No, I didn't. It was working yesterday.
Ben: Maybe the Wi-Fi password changed. Do you remember the password?
Mia: I think so. But I don't know how to reconnect it.
Ben: You need to open the app on your phone. Then press the button on the speaker for five seconds.
Mia: OK. ... The light is flashing blue now.
Ben: Good. Now choose your Wi-Fi network in the app and type the password.
Mia: Done. The light is green. It's working! Thank you.
Ben: You're welcome. By the way, you can also use it to play music. Just say 'Play my playlist'.
Mia: Really? I'll try that later. I'm happy it's fixed.
Ben: Me too. Remember to keep the app updated to avoid problems.
Mia: I will. Thanks again!

grammar.title: to do 表目的；动词后接 to do / doing；基础被动语态
grammar.explanation: 1. 用 to do 表示目的，例如“I want to use it to control my lights.”中 to control 表示目的。2. 有些动词后接 to do，如 want to do, need to do, remember to do；有些动词后接 doing，如 avoid doing, finish doing。3. 被动语态表示“被……”，结构是 be + 过去分词，例如“It is connected to Wi-Fi.”表示它被连接到Wi-Fi。
grammar.example: I want to use it to control my lights.

questions.prompt: She opened the app ___ the speaker.
questions.explanation: 表示目的用 to do，所以选 to reconnect。
questions.evidence: I don't know how to reconnect it.

questions.prompt: You need ___ the button for five seconds.
questions.explanation: need 后接 to do，所以选 to press。
questions.evidence: You need to open the app on your phone.

questions.explanation: 被动语态表示“被连接”，结构是 be + 过去分词，所以选 is connected。
remember 后接 to do 表示记得去做，所以选 to keep。
questions.evidence: Remember to keep the app updated to avoid problems.
